page_title: VER 0-3 MON | Verona v Monza 21/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Samuele Vignato (Monza) on for Dany Mota.
85' That will be all from Matteo Pessina who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Roberto Gagliardini (Monza).
85' Alessandro Nesta decides to make a substitution. Milan Djuric will be replaced by Mirko Maric (Monza).
83' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' Dany Mota (Monza) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.

79' 0 - 3 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Alessandro Bianco (Monza) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:3.
78' Suat Serdar (Verona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Domagoj Bradaric as he is replaced by Davide Faraoni (Verona).
77' Andrea Carboni (Monza) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lorenzo Montipo, who smothers the ball.
74' 0 - 2 Dany Mota (Monza) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.

73' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) attempts to beat Stefano Turati with a header from the corner kick. He sends his effort low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a nice save. The score remains the same.
73' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
72' Alessandro Nesta prepares a substitution. Gianluca Caprari is replaced by Alessandro Bianco (Monza).
72' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) comes onto the pitch so that Pedro Pereira can be given a rest.
71' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' Substitution. Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) replaces Darko Lazovic.
68' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
68' The ball is cleared after Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.
62' It's time for a substitution. Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) comes on in place of Tomas Suslov.
62' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Amin Sarr (Verona) replaces Daniel Mosquera.
61' Substitution. Suat Serdar (Verona) in, Ondrej Duda out.
61' OFF THE BAR! Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
59' Darko Lazovic (Verona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
58' Matteo Pessina (Monza) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
57' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
55' The opposition give Gianluca Caprari (Monza) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
53' Ondrej Duda (Verona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

52' Milan Djuric (Monza) has a great opportunity but fails to score. The ball from the corner falls to him to unleash a shot towards the middle of the target, but the keeper pulls off a decent save to deny him.
52' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) will take the corner.
52' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Monza will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' A quickly taken corner by Monza.
51' Dany Mota (Monza) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Monza.
50' Milan Djuric (Monza) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
48' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.

47' What a chance that is! Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly over the crossbar.
47' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
46' Darko Lazovic (Verona) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Stefano Turati anticipates well and smothers the ball.
46' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' The referee shows the yellow card to Daniele Ghilardi (Verona).
44' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post.
43' A cross into the box from Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is cleared.
41' Andrea Carboni (Monza) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
38' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
38' Dany Mota (Monza) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Monza.
35' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
33' Ondrej Duda (Verona) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
29' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. Verona win a corner.
24' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

23' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) attempts to beat Stefano Turati with a header from the corner kick. He sends his effort towards the bottom left corner of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a nice save. The score remains the same. Verona will take a corner kick.
23' Ondrej Duda (Verona) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
22' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The ball goes out of play and Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.
21' Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to intercept the corner from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza).

20' Dany Mota (Monza) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. Monza will have a chance to score from a corner.
19' Warren Bondo (Monza) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
15' Verona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
14' Darko Lazovic (Verona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
13' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Casper Tengstedt (Verona), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.

9' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Dany Mota (Monza) fires a brilliant volley into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Gianluca Caprari provided the assist. What a finish! 0:1.
9' Dany Mota (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
7' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.

5' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Monza will take a corner.
3' Andrea Carboni (Monza) tries to find Georgios Kyriakopoulos with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Monza will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Federico Dionisi.
